messages:
aj: Quick poll: which mug becomes the official "Redwood Chalice"? Drop emoji to vote.
aj: Options: 1) Big Blue Fiesta :large_blue_circle: 2) Dumpster Cat (cracked but beloved) :cat: 3) Golden Sticker Mug :star: 4) Tiny Handle Mug (too angry) :angry:
maria: Big Blue for me. It survived the dishwasher apocalypse last year. :thumbsup:
sam: Dumpster Cat forever. it's got character. also it knows too much. :eyes:
kelly: Golden Sticker Mug but only if we retire it with a tiny plaque. :trophy:
aj: Pls no plaque that says "mug boss" again, remember the stapler incident. :grimacing: 
maria: @sam what did the dumpster cat see? :joy:
sam: it saw me re-heating ramen at 2am. we are bonded. :ramen:
ops-bot: Reminder: office mugs are not to be taken home. (automated note)
kelly: can we do a tiny ceremony? confetti? someone bring kazoo? :sparkles:
aj: I'm proposing a 24-hour vote window. winner gets the honor of being on the snack shelf next to the jar of ancient jelly.
maria: vote cast :large_blue_circle:
sam: vote cast :cat:
kelly: vote cast :star: 
aj: tally in 24h. honorary title suggestions welcome: "Chalice of Throughput", "Artifact of Iteration", "The Token Mug". 
maria: "Chalice of Throughput" is peak infra vibes. love it. :heart:
sam: 'Artifact of Iteration' feels very PR-friendly. :clap:
kelly: if Golden Sticker loses I'm putting a sticker on the Big Blue. hope you all can handle the consequences. :smirk:
aj: noted. also if anyone tries to put the mug in their bag after the vote, the stapler will be unleashed. :sunglasses:
ops-bot: Vote window expires at 2099001234 + 86400s (24h).
